conventions.encoding: ascii, lf line endings, 2-space indent, trailing newline
conventions.determinism: no timestamps, commit hashes or release numbers; entity lists sorted by id (ordinal) except semantically ordered lists

source_reference.symbol: optional; every dot-separated segment occurs in the file
source_reference.resolves_against: https://github.com/NSTA1/Orleans.Lattice at the ref the site was built from

uncertainty_marker.issue: GitHub issue number tracking the gap, when filed

conventions.package_ids: NuGet package ids in published casing
conventions.empty_list: the entity sources, read in full, state none
